description: Everything needed to start building a planned stack: the decisions (each service, what it covers, the runner-up, cost now and at forecast), setup steps in order (domain, hosting, database, sign-in, email, payments, monitoring), the variable names as .env.example, KONG.md (a brief for the AI assistant: the stack, rules, cost cliffs, setup order, and what "done" means), an acceptance checklist and cost guardrails. For a plan built with an app builder (builder_profile non_developer), KONG.md is one prompt to paste into the builder instead. Pass the share_url of a plan (no sign-in needed) or the id of a saved plan (needs sign-in). Write KONG.md and .env.example into the project root, then follow the steps with the user. Values never pass through Kong Reviews: only variable names.

framework.description: What the app is built with: nextjs (default), remix (Remix or React Router), sveltekit, astro, expo (React Native) or node (Express). Picks each service's package, variable names and guide for it. Read it from the project (package.json) when you can.

id.description: A saved plan id from list_saved_stacks (needs sign-in).

share_url.description: A plan link from plan_stack, recommend_stack or kongreviews.com.

name: get_build_pack

assumptions.description: Usage and pricing assumptions behind the numbers.

caveats.description: Show to the user word for word.

data.description: The tool result. Its shape depends on the tool.

disclosures.description: Always includes the neutrality note: no vendor pays for a place in the answer. Link its url when you mention how Kong Reviews is paid.

title: Get the build pack for a planned stack
